name: outreach-console-mcp
description: Codex plugin for a local job-application outreach pipeline with confirmation-gated provider actions.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a local job outreach pipeline.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local Outreach Console backend for application tracking, company history, contact enrichment, individualized writing, email-provider drafting, recovery handling, and carefully gated sending. Provider credentials remain outside the assistant, sensitive data is opt-in, and paid or external actions require an exact two-step confirmation.
